macros.name: DeclareOpenAccessEprintAlias
macros.doc: Handle the open access URL detection for ⟨alias⟩ exactly as that for ⟨eprinttype⟩.

macros.name: DeclareOpenAccessEprintUrl
macros.doc: Declares the eprinttype ⟨eprinttype⟩ to be an ‘open access eprint type’. The code for ⟨url spec⟩ should expand to the full URL under which the entry can be accessed.
